intent: Research sealed lead MS-0115 as an Evidence-first policy-and-production trajectory: semiconductor-equipment export controls can change the ability of China-based memory fabs to migrate technology or expand capacity even when installed fabs continue operating. Preserve operating-fab evidence, memory-specific regulatory thresholds, VEU authorization state and later authorization revocation as separate point-in-time claims. Do not convert policy status into a synthetic DRAM/NAND bit-supply estimate unless a source explicitly quantifies the effect.
rationale_summary: MS-0115 adds a distinct supply-side policy mechanism after MS-0112 closed a demand-side bridge. Official company sources can establish operating DRAM/NAND fabs in Wuxi/Xi'an; BIS sources can establish 2022 memory-specific licensing thresholds, 2023 VEU authorization and the later revocation state. Existing source/Evidence/orchestration/execution owners are sufficient; the first step remains Evidence-only and must keep operating capacity, authorization state, technology migration and future bit supply separate.
